name: sessions
description: The Claude app's session list inside the CLI: every local and cloud session grouped by repository, and a session view with its transcript, a composer and action keys. /sessions, or . alone in an empty prompt; Esc goes back.

band.title: Line above the prompt when a session needs you
band.description: While the Sessions pane is closed, read the session list every 2 minutes and show one line above the prompt when a session holds a message for you or waits for a permission.
